title: The ordinary universal counit commutes with the derived boundary
statement: For universal base-derived tensor cohomology models m1 and m3 of the first and third vertices of an A-cochain triangle, equip m1.derived and its counit with compatible integer shifts. Every tensor-algebra-linear map s2 whose B-restriction is the canonical derived homology connecting map commutes with the ordinary model comparison maps and the actual ordinary homology boundary. No distinguishedness or flatness assumption is needed.

proof.text: Use shift naturality of the counit and the Qh and homotopy homology factorization isomorphisms. The pure-tensor formula proves ordinaryIso naturality for the third triangle arrow, including shifts. Restriction homology commutes with shifts. Compose these squares, substitute comparison_eq and the assumed boundary formula, and use faithful restriction.
